title: AI Agents Now Process 76% of All Tokens on OpenRouter
summary:
OpenRouter's October data shows that autonomous AI agents drove the majority of platform traffic, using approximately 600 trillion tokens out of a total 790 trillion processed throughout the month. The use of agentic API keys now accounts for 76% of the platform's total token volume, a sharp rise from 8% one year ago.

The platform has seen its monthly token volumes grow 25 times since January, reaching an annual run rate of 10 quadrillion tokens in early November. According to company data, token volumes have doubled every 10.5 weeks, accelerating as the weekly processing rate grew from 1 trillion to 100 trillion tokens over a 78 week period.
